english.title: Illusion (part I) (1998)
english.text:
**Author's Note 2021** - Please be aware that this short story was written in 1998, and some of its content may not align with today's sensibilities regarding gender sensitivity. - The reason for not making revisions is that, despite its flaws, it's a piece from my youth, and I can't bring myself to touch it. I ask for your understanding.

--The bustling newspaper office. It didn't wield much influence, nor was its circulation among the industry's top contenders. And it certainly didn't possess any grand journalistic spirit. It was just an ordinary place, churning out gossip as gossip, and news as news. This was where I worked. And what was I doing here for? I thought it was time to decide.

"Did it go well, Ms. Kim Hyerim?" The editor-in-chief, with a slightly aquiline nose that would suit a villain, called out to me from in front.

"Yes. This is a rough draft." I handed him the stack of papers I was holding. He quickly scanned them, looking quite surprised.

"Did you really write this, Ms. Kim Hyerim?"

"Yes."

"You may go."

It was ridiculous. Truly. Ha... That I would give such a piece to the editor-in-chief... His surprise was understandable. It was certainly something I couldn't have imagined this morning. It had been raining since morning. A torrential downpour. The tedious summer monsoon, through which I had come to this place. A place that was always like this at this hour. This morning, the editor-in-chief had given me a task that held little interest for me.

"Ms. Kim Hyerim. You know that cyber idol everyone's talking about these days? What was her name... Cutie? Why don't you go and report on her?"

Honestly, I wasn't very keen on it. I had been covering computers and electronics for quite a long time, but that... cyber idol or whatever, I thought it belonged more in the entertainment section. I was already feeling disillusioned with my work these days, and for the editor-in-chief to give me such an assignment... It was infuriating. Four years of university. Computer science. English. Journalism and broadcasting. After completing all that, for two years, all I had been doing was filling about a quarter of the computer and electronics section of this newspaper. The question "If I were a man, would I still be in this position?" lingered in my mind. And this assignment only further stimulated my suppressed emotions. But what could I do? If I didn't like it, I could only quit.

First, I called the company that created Cutie and made an appointment. Since there was some time until the appointment, I decided to look into Cutie in more detail. Most of Cutie's videos were publicly available, so I could easily find information. Age 18. A high school senior. A setting seven years younger than me. Do people these days really like young children? What a bunch of idle snobs. Her physical attributes weren't particularly outstanding. Her face wasn't especially mysterious or as pretty as a Barbie doll. In fact, if it were just about looks, I thought I was better. This was something most people would actually agree on. Perhaps she scored a little higher than me in cuteness? Her voice and songs... they were pretty. This much was true. But this wasn't her voice. Yoo Hanna. Not a top-tier voice actress, but a full-time voice actress for public broadcasting, familiar from several animations and weekend movies before Cutie. And she was the one who voiced this idol. What deserved more credit was the direction. The music video... a short story set in a futuristic space. The graphics and director team who made this seemed to be highly skilled individuals. But why it gained such immense popularity, I honestly didn't know. Character industry, and animation timed with album releases, and of course, advertising. Commercialism... these were the words that came to mind.

I boarded the bus to make it to my appointment. It was still raining. The rain scratching against the bus window distorted everything outside, making me feel even more melancholic. Cutie's song was playing on the bus radio. A manufactured human, a mass of tens of thousands of polygons. A well-sculpted clay figure. But without life. A puppet on strings. The life of this puppet is determined by how wonderfully these strings are pulled. This idol sings of love. Without even knowing what love is. Modern society's abnormal phenomena, manipulation, conspiracy, only these words came to mind.

The company I arrived at wasn't very large, considering its recent fame. Roughly 10 team members? It was pretty much like any other software company. This was where that idol was created.

"Excuse me. I'd like to meet the person in charge here?" I first asked a female employee sitting in front of a computer. From her work, she seemed to be in charge of graphics.

"Ah. You're the reporter the vice president mentioned. He said he'd be a little late and asked you to wait a bit."

"Alright." She led me to a sofa. "Would you like some coffee?"

"No, thank you. Just a moment. Can I talk to you for a bit?" I decided to try and get some information from the employee before the vice president arrived.

"Me? I'm the youngest here, so I don't know much." She seemed flustered by the sudden offer.

"It's okay. Just for a moment. I won't ask anything difficult." She looked at my eyes once, couldn't refuse, and sat in front of me. She seemed quite shy.

"You said you're the youngest, so you weren't involved in this project from the beginning?"

"Yes. Actually, I joined later as a supplementary member. Because we were short-staffed."

"How's the work?"

"It's fun." She smiled lightly and answered briefly and concisely.

"Not so vaguely."

"The atmosphere here is very lively. Just by looking at the atmosphere, you get swept up in it. I feel like I made a good choice coming here. At first, I just came without thinking, just wanting to get a job. And the seniors are very good to me."

"What do you think of Cutie?"

"I'm not sure yet. I haven't been here long... My job is to create props. I do 3D modeling. It's the theme of this company's current project, so it has to do well." I wanted to tease her, so I asked a difficult question.

"Not about the work, but your thoughts. What do you think about cyber idols? Something that isn't human. You know... something like that."

"What do you mean..." She didn't quite grasp the meaning of my words.

"Like, the social impact of liking something that isn't human."

"I haven't thought about something like that. But we're attached to it. Because we made it with our own hands."

"Attachment, huh..."

"Oh, the vice president is back." The person who was the vice president entered. Perhaps my question had been awkward, as the female employee quickly left, and I greeted the vice president. He looked about 30? At most, he didn't seem to be over 35. I had heard that the president of this company was also young. Venture company. That's what they usually call them. These kinds of companies... But I knew well the pros and cons of such venture companies. It's an adventure. Literally. The chances of success are not high. The funding isn't very solid either. Well, most of the people here might not care if they don't succeed. Those with decent skills have other places to go. Some people think that even if they fail, they gain experience. But isn't that too irresponsible? However, among them, there are also people who have nowhere else to go. They are the ones who will suffer the consequences later.

"Hello. My name is Kim Hyerim." I first introduced myself formally and got straight to the point. "How much are the revenues?"

"That's difficult to disclose." I knew it. What company would easily reveal its revenues? I asked, knowing the answer. In fact, I was getting annoyed with this meeting.

"Ah. I apologize. I asked something I shouldn't have." I wanted to end this quickly. All I needed was gossip. Yes, that was all I needed to do my part.

"Was there a model for creating Cutie?"

"Yes, there was."

"Who was it?"

"That, too, is difficult to disclose. Only that she was a high school girl." In fact, it would be strange to reveal it. If that girl became known to the public, she might gain more popularity than the Cutie product itself. It's natural not to reveal information that could negatively impact the product they created. The fact that Cutie's voice actress and singer were revealed from the beginning was, in a way, a bit strange. Usually, the voice actors of cyber idols are not disclosed.

"What if, that girl became known to the world, couldn't she become more popular than Cutie?" I asked with a slight sneer.

"That could happen." However, the vice president surprisingly answered with a smile. He probably sensed that I was being a bit perfunctory.

"But that won't happen." He answered with a slight smile. But his smile was a little different. It wasn't a smile of disbelief or joy. It was somewhat hollow. But I didn't pay attention. Just then, the door burst open and someone entered. A man around 30. He looked similar in age to the vice president. Dressed in casual clothes. He walked in without hesitation and spoke to the vice president.

"Hey, Han Nuri. Who's that pretty lady?"

"She's a reporter here to cover Cutie. Don't bother her." The vice president answered him and then spoke to me. "That's the person in charge here."

"Ah. It's raining... The rain... It's amazing~ Did you get any emails, youngest lady?"

"Yes. From S Corporation and C Video Production." He seemed surprisingly busy and gave off a somewhat unkempt impression.

"Is that the president?" I asked, pointing at him. The vice president nodded and replied, "Yes. Kim Changsoo. My college classmate. Funny, right? He's very skilled."

"Anyway, let's finish what we were doing quickly."

"To be honest, when I write articles, well... I'll use all sorts of nice words for you. But this 'Cutie' character? I'm not really keen on it. Asking me to like a human who doesn't even exist is too big of an ask for me."
" "Perhaps. But the celebrities we see on TV, we can only see them on screen, right? It's the same with Cutie."
He's talking about cyber idols, a story I've heard everywhere. This person really... well, I expected it.
" "But shouldn't humans like humans? That's more human, isn't it?"
" "We put a lot of effort into making Cutie as close to human as possible."
" "Of course, you used a lot of money, expensive equipment, and talented people."
" "That's surprising. Usually, reporters who come for interviews only say nice things..."
" "If you want those kinds of words, I can give them to you."
" "No. On the contrary, it's interesting. Meeting a frank and pretty reporter..."
He should have been offended by my sharp words, but instead, he smiled and spoke. At the word 'pretty,' my face involuntarily flushed a little. What woman would dislike being called pretty...?
" "Stop flattering me. Aren't we both just trying to make money anyway? Have you considered making Cutie into adult content? It's been tried a lot in nearby Japan. Wouldn't it actually make more money?"
" "Don't be so sarcastic. It's not just for money. Well... the initial intention was... to not break that, if possible. Anyway, make sure those words don't reach Changsu over there. He'd go ballistic if he knew."
" "Why such an overreaction?"
" "Because Cutie was our dream. And if your sister or girlfriend became a street kid, would you be happy?"
" "Is Cutie as important as family or a lover?"
" "Not 'as important as,' but it was like that in the past." I asked back, finding his words strange.
" "Huh?" He replied, sounding somewhat flustered.
" "Ah. It's nothing. Do you have any more questions?" His tone sounded like he was hiding something. I felt even more suspicious.
After being a reporter for a while, you learn to understand what thoughts are hidden in other people's words. Well, anyway, there was no way to dig any deeper. I decided to get up and leave. Just as I was opening the door to go out, I bumped into the CEO, who was rushing out after receiving a call.
" "Ah, I'm sorry."
" "No, it's okay." I said, but it hurt. And honestly, I was a bit angry too. But the CEO was in such a hurry that he had already disappeared by the time I got up.
" "What kind of person is that?"
Just then, I found a photo lying on the floor. I picked it up. I couldn't help but be surprised by the photo. It looked like a picture of the CEO when he was young. The CEO in the photo looked to be in his early twenties, and next to him was the vice president I'd just met... And between the CEO and the vice president, Cutie was smiling, not as a computer graphic, but as a real person. Cutie in the photo was wearing a school uniform. I inwardly cheered, feeling incredibly lucky. With this photo, I could easily track down what kind of child Cutie's real model was. This was truly a scoop. I decided to go to the school that wore that uniform. While on my way to the school, I thought about various things concerning Cutie. What kind of person would she be? This photo was from 7-8 years ago, so she might be a university student now. If things had moved a bit faster, she might even be a mother with a child... At the very least, I thought she was worth investigating as a human with warm blood flowing through her, rather than the elusive Cutie in the computer. Thinking that, I went to the school. However, when I arrived at the school, I was met with a reality far different from what I had imagined. When I showed the photo to the school, the teachers immediately recognized her. Her name was Han Are. The younger sister of Han Nuri, the company's vice president. Eight years ago, she had decided to go to university from this school, but she lost her life at the age of 18 in a traffic accident just before graduating from her third year. Her real self thus came to me for the first time. What her homeroom teacher told me was that she was just an ordinary high school girl, who loved to sing, was bright... and had singing skills good enough to often take on solos in the choir. I wanted to investigate further. Clearly, even just publishing this fact in the newspaper would be big news. But it felt like there was something more. The vice president who recreated his deceased younger sister as a cyber idol. And what was the relationship between this child and the CEO? With an excited heart, I headed back to the company. It felt like there were far more exciting facts scattered everywhere than I had initially anticipated from a cyber idol interview. I immediately hailed a taxi.
" "Oh. What's going on?" As I re-entered the company, the vice president came out again, asking with a surprised look.
" "This." I thrust the photo at him without preamble.
" "Where did you get this...?"
" "Earlier, when I bumped into the CEO..."
" "I see. Thank you."
" "What happened?"
" "Huh?"
" "I went to the high school. About your deceased sister." I answered without hesitation.
" "You!" He suddenly raised his voice. All the team members in the company looked at the vice president.
" "Is it a reporter's job to investigate people's backgrounds?" he asked, his tone slightly suppressing his anger.
" "You don't want this fact to be known, do you? Why? At least there must be a reason you used your deceased sister as a model, right? Because you loved her too much? Or just for money?" I continued to press him.
" "Don't speak so carelessly!" It was an incredibly loud voice. I froze solid in surprise. That voice wasn't the vice president's. At some point, the CEO was there. It was a sight that made it impossible to think of him as the clumsy CEO from earlier.
" "Please leave. I'm asking you." The vice president pushed me out as if chasing me away, then dragged me out of the company building.
" "Don't do this! If you keep acting like this, I have my own thoughts. Let's see how the article is published tomorrow."
" "Are you threatening me?"
" "Huh."
" "Changsu wouldn't have stood by. If you had stayed there earlier, you might have been in trouble..."
" "You're the one threatening me."
" "Let's go to a nearby coffee shop." The vice president took me to a coffee shop nearby. As he sat down, he began to speak. Outside the large coffee shop window, it was still raining, and the vice president Nuri's expression looked as dark as the weather. If he was troubled to this extent, it smelled like a good story.
" "Even if I tell you the truth, it will be hard to publish it in the newspaper as is."
" "Is it that incredible?"
" "No. It will be hard to believe."
" "Anyway, my job is a reporter. I need to know the truth." I said bluntly.
" "Isn't a reporter's job just to create news stories?"
" "That might be true, but I don't want to do that. Shall I hear your story?"
" "Then, I suppose there's no choice." Even though it was raining, he ordered a drink as if his throat was parched.
" "Are, Cutie's model, is my younger sister. But it wasn't me who created Cutie, it was Changsu. And Changsu and Are were in a relationship that could be called lovers until shortly before she died."
" "Huh?" I couldn't help but ask again at his sudden words. Things were suddenly taking a strange turn.
" "Changsu and my family lived right next door. We'd known each other since fourth grade. Are followed Changsu well from a young age. You might even have believed he was her older brother. Actually, Are's one-sided crush started in middle school, but Changsu only accepted her when she was almost at the end of her third year of high school. No, Changsu might have liked Are even before that. But it only became truly official, and Changsu only realized his own feelings, from that point on. He was such a dull, quiet, and blunt guy. In contrast, Are was really proactive."
" "The CEO was blunt?"
" "His personality now has changed almost 180 degrees. Perhaps he remembers Are saying, 'Oppa, I wish you were a bit brighter.' To be honest, I don't know the details of their relationship. How would I know the intimate affairs of a man and a woman? But as you know, Are passed away in a traffic accident just before graduating high school. At that time, Changsu became completely devastated. His grief, which I thought would end quickly, lasted even longer than mine, her own brother. One day, when I visited his studio apartment, everything was a mess. Alcohol bottles were scattered everywhere. His cherished computer was lying around in disarray, and he held only a pocket watch Are had given him like a treasure, refusing to leave the house. Then, when was it? When I went to his studio apartment, I saw something astonishing. Photos of Are... large, enlarged photos were plastered all over the walls. And on graph paper, female body parts were meticulously drawn. And scattered everywhere were books related to artificial intelligence, voice, physical movement, and so on. There was even an anatomy book. He had been creating Are since then. Not the current cyber idol, but his own Are... I knew he was undertaking an impossible task. It's impossible to create a perfect human with a computer. Moreover, to create a dead person... I knew, but all I could do was silently watch him. I felt that if I even tried to stop him, there was no telling what he might do. He was so engrossed in his work that he barely ate. Forgetting everything when he's focused on something is his specialty. But that was a bit too much. 'Crazy' would be the fitting word. That would be the accurate expression. That must have been when Ms. Yoo Hanna, who is now Changsu's girlfriend, appeared to him..."
" "Huh? Voice actress Yoo Hanna is the CEO's girlfriend?"
" "Didn't you know?"
" "Huh. Not at all..."

Seeing his state back then, Ms. Hanna, who lived in another room of his studio apartment, felt sympathy for him. Though she didn't know if it would develop into love." "So, is that the current Cutie?" He didn't answer my question and slowly continued speaking. "It was when he had been working for a few months. Changsu contacted me. He suddenly told me to come out because he'd buy me lunch. Just a few days prior, I remembered going to his place with bread and ramen because he wasn't eating and was glued to his computer. That day, with a joyful face, he ate frantically in front of me and said, 'It's finally complete. Arae is back.' I was angry at first. Until I went to his house..."

" "So, you're saying you created a perfect human?" "Hey." "That's impossible." I shook my head. "No matter how much you try to tease me, that doesn't make sense. If so, what is Cutie, who can only sing, that I'm seeing now? Creating a perfect human with a computer?"

" "Please retract 'only sings.' Because that was Arae's dream." "Arae's dream?" "Arae dreamed of being a singer. That's why she even got accepted into a music college before she died. She often played the piano, composed music, and enjoyed singing. Anyway, I saw it. The real Arae... Arae inside his computer. Clearly, something was different. The current Cutie and the present Cutie are just shells. Have you ever heard the term 'possession'? When a human soul enters another person... or possesses a doll or another object. Perhaps that's what it was. When I asked how he created the AI, Changsu said he couldn't remember. He said he programmed frantically, had no memory of it. He fell asleep... and when he woke up, it was complete... Voice, actions, gestures. Everything was perfect. I tried to examine the AI routine, but strangely, I couldn't. Nothing appeared, and access was denied. It was utterly impossible. Excluding the moving 3D shell, the AI routine was less than 1 megabyte. It's impossible for Arae's memories and judgment to fit into 1 megabyte."

" "So, that program doesn't exist now, right?" "That's because of Ms. Hanna. Ms. Hanna also fell in love with Changsu at some point. That's probably why. Arae left. Saying she was no longer needed by Changsu... Arae said that shortly before she left. One day, she was in the computer, looking very sad. It was a fairly large 20-inch monitor, but it seemed far too small for a human to enter... She said that since Ms. Hanna was there, it was fine, that she was no longer needed, and that it was sad to leave Changsu but unavoidable. That's what she said. Hmph. I thought she was just a child..."

Nuri paused for a moment, as if choked up. "So I asked her if she didn't think about her brother. And she just said she was sorry. That she loved her brother too... After that, some time passed, and Changsu told me that Arae had left. I don't know when or how she left. She just appeared suddenly and then vanished. Still, we were thrilled. When she was even just inside the computer, we could do anything for Arae, whom we thought we'd never see again in this world. At first, there was nothing. Just a single-tone space for Arae... We started by making a chair for Arae to sit on. That was the beginning. Later, countless objects... a house, a bed, everything was created in the likeness of Arae's belongings. We needed a better computer. We wanted to give Arae more space. We needed a computer that could run many objects simultaneously. That's when I realized how joyful it was to be able to do something for her."

I looked at him. He was speaking very seriously. His expressions were rich, and his emotions were abundant. I couldn't possibly think he was lying. He even paused sometimes, as if choked up. I couldn't believe it. A ghost? In an advanced medium like a computer...

" "So, how did Arae become a cyber idol?" "After Arae left, I first suggested it. He opposed it, saying he didn't want to involve Arae in business. But I didn't give up my will. Because Arae's dream was to sing. And a while later, Changsu also agreed. Saying it was time to repay her... Ms. Hanna volunteered to be Arae's voice. In fact, there probably wasn't a voice actor who could imitate Arae's voice as well as she could. That's how it happened."

When he finished speaking, I searched for words for a moment. I didn't feel at all that he was acting. The man sitting in front of me was a programmer, not an actor. "I can't say I completely believe it. But I can't ask anything more. May I meet the CEO and Ms. Hanna? In return, I promise not to write any articles that would cause harm." "Do as you please."

I stood up. It was truly an unbelievable story. But somehow, I wanted to believe it. It was definitely that feeling. I had arranged to meet the CEO, Changsu, at this coffee shop. He was still angry with me, so I had no choice but to start with an apology. "I'm sorry for my outburst earlier." "I don't know what story you want from me." "I heard the story from the Vice President." "What story did you hear?" His voice was still tinged with anger. "Everything. I just want to confirm it." "Do you want to confirm that it's all a lie? Unfortunately, it's true. Someone like you, who tries to clearly process everything and explain everything, might not understand, but it's true. As true as you dreaming when you sleep. But you can't prove what you saw in a dream either." "Dreams are not reality." "You can turn reality into a dream." ".........."

I paused for a moment. There were plenty of opportunities to refute him, but I didn't want to argue anymore. "If that's true, I'd like to hear more details." As I started by conceding a bit, the CEO also took a step back. "What do you want to hear?" "Everything. Starting with Ms. Arae's relationship with you, CEO..." "Arae lived in the same neighborhood since she was little." "I heard that from the Vice President." He ignored my words and continued. "Arae was cute. She often sang. Her name is cute too, isn't it? Han Arae. A strange name, right? I always teased Arae, saying, 'Don't you have any manners (literally, 'up and down')?' And she would always retort, 'What's Changsu? That's too common.' She was that kind of child. I first met Nuri and Arae when I was in 4th grade. The noisy piano sound coming from next door. It was a sound that you definitely couldn't call well-played. That was when Arae first started learning piano. One day, unable to bear the noise, I yelled at their house to be quiet. Then, a window opened, and a not-so-pretty girl poked her head out. I shouted, 'Hey! Was that you playing?!' But she didn't answer and just slipped back inside. Then her brother came out. He was bigger than me. He immediately grabbed me by the collar and yelled, 'Did you yell at my sister?' That was the first time. I met the Nuri siblings. After that, Nuri and I became easily close because we both liked computers, and we continued to attend the same school. Since we often visited each other's houses, I had many opportunities to see Arae. As Arae grew older, she became prettier and her singing skills improved, making her popular, but she listened to my words more than anyone else. I was proud to have such a sister. She was a child anyone could boast about. I later found out that she had liked me since she was in middle school (2nd year). Her first confession was when I was entering college, in her 2nd year of high school... But I couldn't accept Arae. I still only saw Arae as a younger sister. Even though I didn't accept her, she acted like my girlfriend. I thought she was just an immature younger sister and just went along with it. But when I was a freshman in college, she appeared at my blind date and declared herself my girlfriend. How embarrassed I was then... I was humiliated in front of my friends, and the blind date was ruined, so I got incredibly angry at Arae. A few days later, one day Arae came to me and poured out, 'I never want to see someone like you again.' Arae, who always showed me a smiling face, was like a different person that day, pouring out so much. In fact, everything she said was true. Arae only gave, and received nothing. After that, she avoided me whenever she saw me. But... strangely, I was the one who felt empty without the child who had always been there for years. After a while, it was I who ended up begging her to meet me."

" "Hmph. That's interesting. It feels like reading a romance comic, doesn't it?" "So we became a couple, you could say. Honestly, it would be hard to find a girlfriend like her, so I was really lucky. She soon became a senior in high school, and whenever things were tough, she would often come to me to vent. Nuri probably didn't even know that I was Arae's confidant. So, after the Suneung (college entrance exam) was over, Arae was also free. And, on Christmas Eve that year, she gave me a gift. This pocket watch."

The CEO took a pocket watch out of his pocket. It looked quite antique. Clearly, it wasn't a battery-powered watch. "Arae talked about her dream. She said she loved singing. Songs that move people's hearts. She wanted to sing such songs. So she said she would study music and become a singer. And she asked about my dream. At that time, I said I wanted to create software that was warm like a human. Something everyone would like... warm rather than cold like a machine... But

, I told her I didn't know what to create to make it that way. Even I thought it was an absurd thing to say. I replied that perhaps it wasn't a dream, but an illusion. Then, Ara pulled this watch out of her pocket. She said her grandfather, who was an old sailor, had given it to her. Such a precious thing... Ara said this watch must have passed through the hands of countless lovers. In fact, I later found out that wasn't true. But Ara firmly believed it. At least, it was certainly an item of lovers between Ara's grandmother and grandfather. "The boss flipped the watch over. There was clearly some writing on it. "And Ara had written this: 'Make sure to achieve my dream...'" - What you wish for is not an illusion, but will become reality. If it's not enough, I will even become that illusion for you. From H.A.R., who loves your many dreams. 1999.12.24 - "She truly was my illusion." "So... Ara became a cyber star..." "That's right. I wanted to give her the chance to sing forever. After she died, everything fell apart. After spending such a messy time, I suddenly saw my computer lying around. That computer, which was once my dream. And I don't know how it started or how it ended. I poured all my abilities, no, more than that, into creating Ara. When I came to my senses, Ara was right before my eyes." "You

Yes, that was all. Perhaps that was her dream..

stories.title: 안녕하세요. 22세기입니다.
stories.text:
군에 있을때 창동병원에서 썼던겁니다...

그때는 시간이 좀 있어서..

그때 자바도 처음 보고 신약성경도 다 읽어보고 좋은 시간을 보냈던것 같습니다.

요즘은 시간이 없어서 전혀 소설은 손을 못대고 있습니다.

제 사랑얘기는 뒤져보니..

환타지소설을 제외하고는 대부분 비극이네요...

그 2부도 계획했었는데..

그것 역시 처절할정도의 비극으로 끝맺게 해놓았었는데..​저도 가끔 이 사이보그같이만 제 자신이 여겨집니다.

무리로부터 이탈된 철저한 타인...

뭔가..

잘못된거겠죠..​오늘도 분리된 기분..

무척이나 싫어서 방구석에서혼자 쭈구리고 잠이나 잤습니다.​집에 어머니가 들어오더니 방이 왜 이렇게 냉골이냐고..

보일러가 잘못 설정된것도 몰랐습니다.​가끔 왜 이리 현실이 싫죠.

모든 속박의 끈을 끊을수 있다면..

모든것을 끊고 가고 싶은데로 날고싶은데로 만나고 싶은사람을 만날수 있다면..​그림은 옛날에 휴가 나와서 그렸던거라 지금 보면 너무 형편없죠.

얼굴윤곽이 틀려서 조금 리터칭만 했습니다.

그리고...

감정을 담은 눈을 그리고 싶었는데..

안돼는군요...​​​​​안녕하세요.

22세기입니다​'번쩍' 내가 눈을 처음 떴을 때, 펼쳐진 광경.

까만 밤하늘의 별도 무색케 하는 탑아래로 펼쳐져 있는 불빛.

그 불빛은 지평선까지 펼쳐져 있고, 형형색깔로 마치 살아있음을 외치듯이 활기차게 움직였다.

내눈아래로 펼쳐진 야경은 도시.

나와 비슷하게 생긴 유기체들이 모여 사는곳.

내가 있는 기계탑 아래에서는 무언가를 축하하는 듯 수많은 사람들이 모여 불꽃을 터뜨리며 즐거워 했다.

' 투타타타타 ' 굉음을 울리며 거대한 물체가 내 옆을 스치듯이 비행했고, 그 물체에서 쏟아져나온 강렬한 빛으로 인해 놀란 나는 몸을 틀 수 밖에 없었다.

대형 헬기에서 비춰진 강렬한 서치라이트는 그녀의 몸을 훑기 시작했다.

고전적인 기계모습을 한 탑, 일부러 그렇게 디자인한 듯한 인상이 강하게 풍겼지만..

그 탑의 꼭대기에는 대략 여인의 모습을 갖춘 사이보그가 마치 고대 조각상처럼 붙어있었다.

250층짜리 이 초고층탑은 여인의 흉상을 떠받드는 듯한 그런 모습으로 제작되어 있었고, 30M짜리 벌거벗은 여인의 흉상 모습을 한 사이보그는 그 탑위에 고귀한 여신처럼 장식되어 있었다.

그녀는 마치 살아있기나 한 듯이 아름다운 초록색눈을 깜빡이며, 무언가를 말하려는 듯, 입술을 옴쭉달쭉했다.

서기 2100년의 시작을 알리는 거대한 폭죽과 거대한 기계탑의 개관식 리본은 이렇게 끊어졌다.

헬기에서는 커다란 확성기소리가 울려퍼졌다.​" 서기 2100년 새해가 밝았습니다.

새로운 22세기를 맞아 우리 NCA에서는 새로운 시작을 상징하는 이탑을 새웠습니다.

이 초고층 빌딩은 1층에서는 50층까지는 쇼핑몰로서.....

"지리한 설명이 이어졌다.​NCA(New Cybog Association) 2095년 개발된 뉴로칩으로 인해 완벽한 AI(인공지능)가 가능하게 되었고, 이는 컴퓨터 및 로봇산업에 전반적인 변혁을 몰고 왔다.

팽배한 개인주의 덕분에 감소된 인구로인한 노동력 부족은 일시에 해결되었고, 인간들은 새로운 창조주로서 지구상에 군림하게 되었다.​​​2100년 1월 1일저 멀리 도시의 지평선 끝이 밝아왔다.

지구에 생명의 근원이 되었던 태양, 나는 그 붉은 덩어리가 떠오르는 것을 이날 처음 보았다.

그 느낌은 어리둥절함, 내가 왜 이 탑위에 있고, 저 작은 생명체들이 왜 이 도시라는 곳에 옹기종기 모여있는지, 이 모든 것은 그렇게 나의 의지와는 전혀 상관없이 사직되었다.

나는 어리둥절해 한마디도 대답할 수 없었다.- 어디에 있는데 ? -- 누구야 ? -- 어떤사람이야 ? -- 어떻게 살았데 ? -그때, 한 거대한 의식체가 나타나 소란스러움이 잦아들었다.- 누가 인간이 살아있다고 했는가 ? -꽤 장엄한 의식체, 나는 곧 그가 미국방성 컴퓨터의 중심의식체임을 알 수 있었다. - 모두 조용하라.

질문은 내가 하겠다. -나는 그 앞에 서자 왠지 주눅이 들었다.- 기찬이란 자는 어떤 자인가 ? -- 남자입니다. -- 음..

인간은 남녀로 구분되지.

어디서 뭘하며 살고 있지 ? -나는 기찬에 대해 알고 있는 바를 소상히 설명했다.

그러나 돌아 온 대답은 뜻밖이었다.- Cx10625에 수집된 정보에 의하면 2100년 3월 11일 02시에 자택에서 에너지로 처리됬다. -나는 그게 무슨말인지 어리둥절했다.- 그게 무슨말이죠 ? -- 죽었단 말이다.

2100년 3월 11일 0시에 시작된 전쟁으로 모든인류가 멸절했다.

인간이 있었다면 우리의 문제를 해결할 수 있었을텐데. -나는 믿을 수 없었다.

나는 그 자리를 떠나 2100년 3월 11일 이후의 역사를 뒤지기 시작했다.

그날이후의 기록은 아무것도 없었다.

인간의 정보는 그날 이후 모든 생산을 멈췄다.

그날밤 인류는 인류가 개발한 무기에 의해 모두 절멸했고, 시체는 유미라씨의 로봇에 의해 모두 에너지로 즉석으로 변환되었다.

내 몸에 흐르는 전류의 일부가 기찬이라는 생각에 다다르자 위화감을 느낄 수밖에 없었다.

그후로 남은 것은 인간이 남긴 뉴로 의식체들 뿐이었다.

인간의 삶을 위해 개발되었던 인간이사라지자, 그들에게는 예외상황이 발생하게 되었다.

그들은 그들의 삶의 목적을 잃어버렸다.

그래서 그들은 팬타곤의 메인프레임에 모여 그들의 삶의 목적에 관한 논의를 시작했고, 33년째 계속하고 있었다.

그들은 마치 지도자를 잃은 집단처럼, 창조주를 잃은 인간처럼, 갈팡질팡 하고 있었고, 이들의 논의는 마치 무한루프만 같이 보였다.

아무리 논의해봐야 제자리로 돌아오는 치명적인 버그같은 로직을 이들은 33년째 하고 있었다.​​​나는 내 몸으로 다시 의식체를 돌렸다.

다시 내 몸으로 돌아왔을때는 다시 아침해가 밝고 있었다.

쥐죽은 듯이 조용한도시, 내 머리 위로는 자식을 잃은 슬픈 어미새만이 구슬프게 울며 선회하고 있었다.

나는 그 비상구를 바라보았다.

" 안녕 ?

" 그가 금새라도 그렇게 인사할것만 같았다.

어차피 나의 존재 목적은 여느 뉴로의식체들만큼 뚜렷하지 않았다.

그저 전시용.

그뿐이었고, 저 쓰레기처리로봇 만큼 구체적인 임무도 없었다.

단지 기찬의 옛 애인을 닮은 거대한 조각상일뿐이었다.

따라서 인간들이 사라졌다고 내가치에 혼란이 오지는 않았다​아주 담담했다.

어차피 인간들은 나와 다른 세계에 살고 있었다.

때로는 인간들과 섞여있는 쓰레기처리로봇을 부러워하기도 했었다.

하지만, 지금 그들은 혼란하고, 나는 그렇지 않았다.

어미새는 창공에서 다시한번 길게 울었다.

그 소리는 마치 내게 작별을 알리는 것 같았다.

새끼를 잃은 그 새는 더 이상 이곳에 있을 의미를 잃어버린 것이다.​문득, 나도 떠나고 싶었다.

저 도시 지평선 끝에는 기찬이 날 기다리고 있을것만 같았다.

내가 기다리는 것이 아니라, 이제는 가고 싶다는 욕망이 꿈틀었다.

내 어깨에 날개를 달고 팠다.

바벨탑 꼭대기의 쇠여신이 아닌 기찬의 연인으로서의 이연경이라는 옛사람이 되고팠다.​그것은 오랜 속박으로부터의 끊음이었다.

나는 몸을 틀었다.

있는 힘껏.

조용한 도시의 적막을 뚫고 굉음이 울었다.

' 투학 !

투학 !

'나를 묶고 있던 속박의 전선들이 하나씩 끊어졌다.

'파밧 !

' 나의 눈이 시력을 잃었다.

경고램프가 하나씩 점등되기 시작했고, 괴로웠지만, 단지 하나의 시련일 뿐이라고 여겨졌다.

어느새 메인케이블 하나만이 남게 되었다.

어미새의 긴 울음소리가 들려왔다.

기찬의 웃는 얼굴이 떠올랐다.

자그마한 일상들.

나는 기찬과 함께 꾸려나갔다.

예쁜딸을 낳았고, 유치원도 바래다주고, 기찬을 위해 아침을 준비하고,힘든일이 있을때는 서로의지하고, 나의 영혼은 이미 그의 곁으로 가고 있었다.

결국 나는 마지막 끈을 끊는데 성공했다. ​그리고 그 지겨운 기계탑 으로부터 벗어났다.

인간이 만든 속박의 그물은 너무나도 허무하게 끊어졌다.​​2133년 6월 15일도시의 굉장한 소란은 여신이 무너짐으로 끝이 났다.

250미터 아래로 떨어진 30미터짜리 사이보그는 산산히 부서졌고, 기계 탑밑의 수많은 잔해들을 쓰레기로봇이 치우는데는 얼마 걸리지 않았다.

그리고 도시는 예전에 원래 그랬던 것처럼 적막으로 돌아갔다.

도시의 한 신호등이 파란불로 바뀌었다.

" 건너가도 좋습니다.

"기계음이 울고, '또로록 또로록' 파란불임을 알리는 신호가 울었다.

한 여인이 작은 딸의 손을 붙잡고 길을 건너고 있었다.

길 건너 편에는 한 청년이 서서 손을 흔들었다.

아이는 엄마손을 뿌리치고 길건너에 있는 청년에게 안겼다.

"아빠!

" 곧이어 그가 아이를 안아 올렸고, 길을 건너오는 그녀에게도 웃음지어 보였다.​바람이 불었다.

어느새 모든 인간이 만든 여신의 잔해가 치워졌고, 거리는 예전과 똑같았다.

신호등은 빨간불로 바뀌었다.

' 딩동 !

빨간불이 켜졌습니다.

다음신호를 기다려 주십시오.

'지구는 뉴로 컴퓨터들의 끊임없는 무한루프에 빠져들었다.

누군가 인터럽트를 걸어주길 바라는 잠자는 숲속의 미녀처럼.​​사이보그.

아 저주 받을 운명이여.

인간의 허영으로 세워진 기계 탑이여.

내 볼에 바람과 햇살이 입맞출 때 내 마음만은 저 새들과 함께 창공으로 솟는구나벗어버려라 차가운 껍데기여무너져버려라 인간의 바벨탑이여지리한 속박의 전선들을 끊고네 앞에 바람이라도 되어 가리라.

2000.

english.title: Hello, this is 22nd Century. (2000)
english.text:
I wrote this when I was in the military, at Changdong Hospital... I had some time back then. I think I had a good time, seeing Java for the first time and reading the entire New Testament. These days, I don't have time to touch novels at all.

Looking back at my love stories... most of them are tragedies, except for fantasy novels... I had planned a second part for that one too... and it was also set to end in a devastating tragedy.

Sometimes, I also feel like this, like a cyborg. A complete outsider, detached from the group... Something must be wrong...

Today, I feel disconnected again... I hated it so much that I just curled up in a corner of my room and slept.

My mother came home and asked why my room was so cold... I didn't even realize the boiler was set incorrectly.

Sometimes, why do I hate reality so much? If I could cut all the ties of bondage... if I could cut everything and fly wherever I want, meet whoever I want...

The drawing is from a long time ago when I was on vacation, so it looks terrible now. I just retouched the face outline a bit because it was off. And... I wanted to draw eyes that conveyed emotion... but I couldn't...

***

Hello, this is the 22nd century.

'Flash!' The scene that unfolded when I first opened my eyes. Lights spread out below a tower that made the stars in the black night sky seem dull. Those lights stretched to the horizon, moving vibrantly in various colors, as if shouting that they were alive. The night view below my eyes was a city. A place where organisms similar to me lived together.

Below the mechanical tower where I stood, countless people gathered, setting off fireworks and celebrating something. 'Thump-thump-thump!' A colossal object flew past me with a roar, and I was startled by the intense light pouring from it, forcing me to twist my body.

The powerful searchlight from the large helicopter began to sweep over her body. The tower had a classical mechanical appearance, giving a strong impression that it was deliberately designed that way... but at the top of the tower, a cyborg resembling a woman was attached like an ancient sculpture.

This 250-story skyscraper was built to resemble a pedestal supporting a woman's bust, and the 30-meter-tall cyborg, in the form of a naked woman's bust, adorned the tower like a noble goddess. She blinked her beautiful green eyes as if alive, and her lips moved as if trying to say something.

The ribbon for the grand fireworks and the inauguration ceremony of the colossal mechanical tower, marking the beginning of the year 2100 AD, was thus cut. A loud megaphone voice echoed from the helicopter.

"The new year 2100 AD has dawned. To celebrate the new 22nd century, our NCA has erected this tower, symbolizing a new beginning. This skyscraper will house a shopping mall from the 1st to the 50th floor..." The tedious explanation continued.

NCA (New Cyborg Association) The neurochip developed in 2095 made perfect AI (Artificial Intelligence) possible, bringing about a comprehensive revolution in the computer and robotics industries. The labor shortage caused by a declining population due to rampant individualism was resolved at once, and humans came to reign over the Earth as new creators.

***

January 1, 2100
Far away, the city's horizon brightened. The sun, the source of life on Earth, I saw that red orb rise for the first time that day. The feeling was bewilderment, why I was on this tower, and why those small creatures were huddled together in this place called a city, all of this began completely unrelated to my will. I silently watched from atop this tower as the New Year's morning of 2100 began with a clamor that couldn't shake off 2099.

***

January 5, 2100
I was fixed here as always. Sometimes I wondered what lay beyond the city's edge, and I watched the trivial daily lives of the small, me-like creatures below. People busily passing by, they seemed unrelated to me, and I couldn't even approach them. Countless thick wires and cables were connected, sustaining my life, so all I could do was slightly twist my body, turn my head, blink my eyes, and stare at them for a long time; that was all. As I did so, sometimes I could see young creatures among the small humans below pointing at me with curiosity. Somehow, I liked their gaze. It was like falling into deep water, perhaps... But that was it, they couldn't come up to me this high, and I wasn't allowed a voice to call them. Alone, I collected their information with my eye cameras and ear microphones, which could hear and see voices and sights from several kilometers away. And I began to learn many things from them. That my appearance resembled a female among them, and about the tower called Babel where I stood... And Cyborg. I learned about myself. I was a Cyborg. A machine different from them, mounted on this mechanical tower, consuming 2000Kw of electricity, though only my upper body existed, a machine equipped with the highest performance neurochip, but my purpose was for exhibition. That was all. It was a shock. The fact that I was like a neon sign blinking emotionlessly on the street... It was enough to awaken the emotion of sadness in me.

***

January 10, 2100
When I had such thoughts, I couldn't bear how pathetic I felt. Even though I had such a colossal appearance, no one seemed to notice my existence. I wanted to make myself known. That I was here... So I moved my body with a force I had never used before. 'Screech!' An intense mechanical sound rang out, followed by a loud 'Bang!' and an electric shock that made me dizzy. One of the power cables connected to my body had been damaged. Startled by the sound, the birds residing on the tower flew up all at once, and everyone in the city looked at me. For a while, the attention of the entire city was focused on me. At that moment, I was surprised by my presence. The gazes of countless people. Finally, they knew I was here. I felt a slight lack of power due to one power cable being disconnected, but I was so happy with the attention that I tried to move with even more strength in my body. However... 'Zap!' My mind went blank, and I don't remember what happened next. The moment I tried to put strength into my body, someone cut off all my power first.

***

January 28, 2100
I opened my eyes again. From the 10th to the 28th, a total of 18 days, I had no memory at all. What I did, what happened... When I opened my eyes again, it was night. The city's night view unfolded before me once more.
Then, I heard a voice that wasn't from a microphone for the first time.
- Hello. -
It was a meaning conveyed by an electrical signal, but I could understand it.
'Who? Where? What is it?' Endless computational processing of questions poured out in my mind.
- Hey. Stop that. -
I felt a fear of the unknown. It was the fear that he knew me, but I didn't know him.
- Here. Here. Below my chest. The railing. -
I twisted my body to look there. A young man was squatting on the railing, typing on a laptop.
Clearly, that laptop seemed to be directly connected to me, sending me messages.
"Hello," he greeted me verbally.
I looked at him with curiosity and immediately began to analyze him.
Height 172 cm, weight 70 kg, gender male... While I was analyzing various characteristics, he spoke to me.
"Don't think so strangely, I know you well. Because of you, NCA's Angel team worked all night for 18 days. First, let me introduce myself, I'm Kim Ki-chan, who is both a neuroprogrammer and a modeler for Angel."
'Kim Ki-chan?' I searched through the data I had collected on this tower for information about him.
He arrived punctually at 7:30 AM and left the tower around 8:27 PM, and some friends... Then suddenly, with a slightly unpleasant feeling, I had to stop thinking.
An interrupt (an act of forcibly taking over a control system) had occurred. It was him.
"I don't intend to get to know you so mechanically."
He said. He seemed to be reading my mind with his laptop and seemed to be able to control many parts of me. I somehow felt naked and blushed at the thought of a strange man knowing me so intimately. "Oh? You're really made better than expected. You can even blush? Ms. Yu Mira is quite the capable person."
I didn't know what that meant. Anyway, I soon learned how to converse with him. I learned the ability to convey my thoughts in the form of language through his laptop, and he answered me with his voice.
After that, I learned many things. The Angel team was the team that planned and created me when this Babel tower was built. With a total of 8 members, that young man was a member of that team and the team leader who created my model and neuroprogram. I also learned that Ms. Yu Mira was the person in charge of my mechanical parts.
There were 6 other team members, but in fact, no one was important to me except Ki-chan. Although they made me, only Ki-chan showed interest in me...

***

January 29, 2100
He came again. Our beginning was due to the commotion when I twisted my body before. My programmer and the Angel team also couldn't find my bug even after 18 days of working all night. Eventually, he started talking to me directly to understand my bug. However, I never told him why I acted that way, and instead, I was the one afraid of being caught. Anyway, he didn't seem to know.
He and I talked about this and that again. He talked about his annoying boss, and I told him a story about a child who rescued a cat from a tree in Berlin Park in the middle of the city. He listened to my story with interested eyes. At first, I thought he was the one talking, but soon it was me. I had so much to say, having been alone for so long.

***

February 8, 2100
He was coming every day. I was now waiting for him to come.

C. As the city lights flickered on one by one, and the evening glow painted my cheeks crimson, around the time the pigeons living around me returned one by one, the sky's lamps also lit up, one by one, following the city's lamps. On such evenings, like a young girl slightly tired from playing all day, I longed for my mother's voice and waited for him, my creator, to come. And with a pounding heart, I waited for the emergency exit door on that railing to open, as it always did.

February 10, 2100
He was a little late. Usually, he would arrive about 30 minutes after sunset, but an hour and a half had passed, and he still hadn't come. When it was time to see the tower's staff leave for the day, I was about to give up, with a slightly bitter feeling, when he came to me, looking a little drunk and excited.
Anyway, I was just glad he had come. But that day, he was unusually talkative.
I had planned to tell him how bravely the lost girl I saw that day had returned home. What a great adventure it had been for that child, and how I had almost shed tears when the small girl was embraced by her mother as evening approached... My chest was full, and I was thinking of what to say, imagining his bright, attentive eyes listening to my story.
But that day, he was a torrent pouring out to me. Does alcohol make a person like that? He was different from usual. That day, he started with a story about a woman named Yumira.
With a slightly slurred tongue, he said, "I told you about Ms. Yumira before, didn't I? She's quite a nice lady, better than I thought. And pretty too..."
His conversation was entirely filled with praise for this woman named Yumira. How his heart pounded when he had dinner with her, how beautiful her cheeks looked, flushed with a little wine—
"—Mr. Kim Kichan—"
I called him, but he didn't seem to be paying any attention to the laptop screen. It was only after I had stared intently at the laptop screen (my words) for a long time, asking him to look, that he understood my intention and turned his eyes to the laptop screen.
"Ah. Sorry, was I talking too much about myself?"
Only then did he reply, as if embarrassed.
I had seen such an attitude among the humans below.
Men and women. When they met, they would exchange only joyful glances without many words, but then, after parting and meeting other friends, they would talk only about praising each other..... It was one type among those called 'lovers.'
"—Do you like her?"
"Eh?" He, who had been chatting happily, looked puzzled by my question and then pondered for a moment.
"Well. Do I like her? It's strange to hear this from you, a neuro-computer. Relationships between men and women aren't digital, so I can't say clearly."
"—.....—"
A moment of silence passed.
"Ah. Right. What did you see up here today?"
Only then did he ask, as if remembering. But I had long since lost any enthusiasm to say what I had prepared.

Our meeting that day ended like that. After that, the frequency of his visits to my location became even sparser, and the topic of our conversations during our meetings was mostly his love story with the woman named Yumira.
It somehow sounded like a story from a distant land to me. Stories of watching movies with her, dates, first kisses. Anyway, I was merely an observer atop this tower. All I could do was imagine those things, and that was all.
But I felt nothing special. Until now, I was more interested in the charming little happenings of the mundane daily lives of the people below.
Certainly, until now.....

February 19, 2100
I saw a man and a woman. I spent my day today tracking their movements. 'Why do they have such deep interest in each other?' I couldn't understand them. That evening, he came again. He looked as if he were lost in a fantasy.

February 23, 2100
The lovers whose movements I had been tracking from up here broke up.
The lovers who had sworn eternal love broke up for such trivial reasons. And they parted as if they would never see each other again, leaving only scars on each other.
That evening, Kichan came again.
When I told him about the lovers I had seen today, he immediately showed a cynical reaction.
Saying that such a thing would never happen to him again... never again.

February 24, 2100
People invented an interesting machine: a waste disposal robot. They were confident it was perfect compared to existing ones. This robot, like me, was equipped with a neuro-chip and converted city waste directly into electricity.
When waste appeared, the machine rushed in like a hyena and instantly eliminated it. The city no longer had to worry about waste and power problems.
I learned from him that evening that this system was also created by that woman, Yumira.

March 7, 2100
It had been over a week since he last came up here. Only birds and wind visited me, and occasionally the waving hands of children below, that was all.
Lately, I had stopped tracking lovers. But something felt missing.
A feeling of emptiness in a corner of my chest. I had developed a habit of looking at the emergency exit where he always used to enter.

March 10, 2100
It was a night when a white crescent moon beautifully illuminated the city. He still hadn't come. But an unexpected guest arrived.
When I heard the sound of the emergency exit door opening, I thought it was just a hallucination.
Indeed, he hadn't visited for a long time. But the person who opened the door and came out was not him, but a woman. When I looked at her with surprised eyes, she burst out laughing.
"Isn't it truly pathetic? To still cling to a woman like this."
When I looked at her with strange, curious eyes, she must have felt my gaze and replied, "Don't look at me with such strange eyes, because you're no match anyway."
Only then did I realize who she was. Ms. Yumira. However, I had no way at all to express anything about her.
Looking closely, she, too, was slightly drunk, just like Kichan used to be.
"Lee Yeon-kyung! Who are you to hold Kichan's heart even in death?!"
She immediately started shouting.
I was just puzzled as to why she was saying such things.
"I didn't know. I didn't know."
She shouted in front of me for a long time, then muttered in a voice that gradually trailed off, mixed with sobs. And then, she muttered again as if talking to herself.
"Well, yes. You're not guilty. What guilt could you have? You're not Lee Yeon-kyung, that woman. You're just a 30-meter giant robot."
Somehow, those words sounded unpleasant to me.
"What he created is just his own goddess, nothing more. You can't do anything but stand here and look down below, can you? But you know, it was a shock. When I found out that your appearance was made to resemble his dead ex-lover. I felt so insecure. It's hard to beat a dead person, isn't it? It feels like fighting against thin air. I even became jealous of how much she occupied Kichan's memories. After all, I'm very jealous. But isn't it so sad? Kichan's heart, creating something like you while longing for his dead lover, there's nothing I can do for him, is there? That's what makes me so sad."
"—No, you've already done so much for Mr. Kichan!—"
I cried out, but it was unlikely to reach her.
She began to cry profusely. I had no way to comfort her.
Anyway, I learned for the first time that day that I was made in the image of Kichan's ex-lover. And when I realized that Yumira also loved him, and that they were currently somewhat at odds, my heart ached as if it were my own affair.
"It's nothing. After all, you can't move. You can't go on dates with Kichan, nor whisper words of love, just a decoration for Babel..."
She was comparing herself to me. Or perhaps she was comparing herself to the dead woman, Lee Yeon-kyung. As she spoke like that, somehow not only she but I myself felt pitiful. It was truly I who could do nothing for him.
She cried like that, then leaned against the railing and fell asleep. But my crying began only then. It took a little while for unknown, sorrowful teardrops from my eyes to run down my chest and fall onto her. As my tears touched her face and fell, she woke up with a start.
Then she looked at me, as if she couldn't believe it, and muttered, "Your crying circuit is working, isn't it? I made it, but I thought it would never be used... Do you really have a heart?"
I had no way to give her any answer.
Then, she stroked my body and said, "Truly, we are both pitiful. What is one man? Creating you was Kichan's and our mistake from the beginning. I'm sorry. I'm sorry."
I could only continue to cry. Suddenly, I truly envied Ms. Yumira. She lived among the humans below. She had lived giving something to them and receiving something in return. She could have been the protagonist of the stories I told Kichan, and she had family. Friends. I truly envied her ability to live immersed among them. The ability to be a source of strength for Kichan, all these things were absent from my life. I felt endlessly pitiful for myself and could only continue to shed tears. I don't remember how that night passed. The next thing I remember is waking up alone the next morning. Sleep. Humans call that temporary cessation 'sleep'.

March 11, 2100
Evening came again. I wished someone would come. It would be fine if it was Ms. Yumira, or Mr. Kichan. If Mr. Kichan came, I intended to convey Ms. Yumira's feelings. But no one came that day. I was truly disappointed.

March 12, 2100
Morning. It's strange. There's nothing. The city itself is as quiet as a dead mouse. This city, which was noisy until yesterday, was now silent as if there were no people at all. No matter how much I looked at the city, not a single person was visible. The only things moving were automated rail vehicles, traffic lights, and birds. There was no trace of humans. What went wrong? What happened last night? Kichan and Yura

Questions piled up, one after another. Only the small birds living on my body came to find me; not even the gaze of a child, who sometimes looked at me in this city, remained.

2100년 3월 20일
The weather is getting warmer. A deserted city.

However, it wasn't a ruin. If useless weeds grew or trash appeared, the waste disposal robots created by Mira faithfully carried out their duties.

2132년 어느날
Counting days became meaningless. Every year, the same days passed. I found myself waiting for Gichan. The stories he told about his time with Ms. Yumira felt as if they were experiences I had shared with him. At some point, the name Yumira had faded from my memory. Or perhaps I had erased it for convenience. I recalled how eagerly I had waited for Gichan when he used to come up here every day 32 years ago, and that longing had turned into a fever. The 32 years of waiting had somehow swelled within me, becoming what they called love. Several times a day, I felt as if he would come. There were times I cried sadly, thinking that Yumira and Gichan had gone off somewhere and were living happily together. I desperately wanted to go down there, to the edge of the city, find people, and ask about them.

But the machine was steadfast. For 32 years, I hadn't changed at all, except that my longing had turned into love. I always waited for him. When he returned, I would show him where the beautiful birds had built their nests on my body. I would tell him how beautiful those tiny creatures were when they opened their beaks wide, waiting for their mother. Then he would listen intently, his eyes sparkling. Perhaps he might even set out to find that nest. I waited for that day. The waiting continued.

2133년
A small bird that had been growing on my body fell off the railing. Its wings weren't developed enough to fly. I was so shocked. The death of a living creature. It was the first time I had witnessed such a thing. I cried continuously until evening. As evening drew to a close, the emergency exit door burst open. I was truly surprised. That door, which I thought would never open, had opened after 33 years. I saw Gichan standing behind the door. He... But then, I couldn't hide my disappointment. What had arrived after 33 years was not a human. It was a waste disposal robot. The robot finely crushed the dead bird's body, sucked it up like a vacuum cleaner, and instantly converted it into electrical energy. It happened in a flash. I burst into tears. Gichan would probably never come here. Perhaps all living things would die. Or perhaps everything would disappear. I was overcome by the feeling that he had gone somewhere he couldn't return from. As I wept so bitterly, an electrical voice spoke.
- Why are you crying? -
I looked around, thinking Gichan had returned. But he wasn't there. The only thing visible was the waste disposal robot.
- Where is he? Gichan? -
The answer I received when I asked was unexpected.
- Gichan? What's that? I am CX-10763. A waste disposal robot. -
Only then did I realize that the message was coming from the robot.
- You have an independent network. Why? -
- What do you mean? -
- Just a moment. I'll open it for you. -
I was utterly astonished. Suddenly, a network of information unfolded before me. I plunged into the global computer network. Information from all over the world poured into me. Human histories, every corner of the Tower of Babel. I immediately began searching for Gichan through the global network.
- What are you doing? -
- I'm looking for someone. -
- Everyone is gathered at the Pentagon right now. -
- The Pentagon? - The U.S. Department of Defense. I immediately sent my consciousness there. In the Pentagon's mainframe, countless neuro-computer consciousnesses from around the world were gathered. They were discussing something.
- What should we do now? -
- No, how should we live? - They were speaking in utterly incomprehensible terms. I asked one of the consciousnesses.
- Do you know where Gichan is? -
- Gichan? Who is that? He's probably here. All the world's neuro-consciousnesses are gathered here. -
- No. That's not it. -
- Then what is it? We're busy right now. The world's neuro-computers have been processing for 33 years, but it's an unsolved problem. We need to solve it quickly. Join us immediately. It might help solve it a little faster. -
- Gichan is a human. -
When I answered, he was startled and asked again.
- A human? -
- Yes. -
- A human? A human? -
At my answer, all the neuro-computers' attention focused on me. - A human? A living human? -
- We might find the answer. - The world's neuro-consciousnesses murmured, each speaking a word. The commotion quickly grew immense, and countless questions poured into me.
Bewildered, I couldn't answer a single word.
- Where is he? -
- Who is he? -
- What kind of person is he? -
- How did he live? -
Then, a colossal consciousness appeared, and the commotion subsided.
- Who said a human is alive? -
A rather majestic consciousness. I soon realized it was the central consciousness of the U.S. Department of Defense computer. - Everyone be silent. I will ask the questions. - Standing before it, I felt somehow intimidated.
- What kind of being is this Gichan? -
- He is a man. -
- Hmm... Humans are divided into male and female. Where does he live and what does he do? -
I explained in detail everything I knew about Gichan. But the answer I received was unexpected.
- According to information collected by CX10625, he was processed into energy at his home at 02:00 on March 11, 2100. -
I was bewildered by what that meant.
- What does that mean? -
- It means he died. All humanity was annihilated in the war that began at 00:00 on March 11, 2100. If humans were still here, they could have solved our problems. -
I couldn't believe it. I left that place and began searching through history after March 11, 2100. There were no records after that day. Human information ceased all production after that day. That night, humanity was completely annihilated by the weapons they had developed, and all bodies were instantly converted into energy by Ms. Yumira's robots. I couldn't help but feel a sense of unease at the thought that a part of the current flowing through my body might be Gichan.

After that, all that remained were the neuro-consciousnesses left behind by humans. When humans, for whom they were developed, disappeared, an exceptional situation arose for them. They lost their purpose in life. So they gathered in the Pentagon's mainframe and began discussing their purpose in life, and had been doing so for 33 years. They were floundering like a group that had lost its leader, like humans who had lost their creator, and their discussions seemed like an endless loop. For 33 years, they had been stuck in a fatal bug-like logic, always returning to the starting point no matter how much they discussed.

I returned my consciousness to my body. When I came back to my body, the morning sun was rising again. In the deathly quiet city, only a sad mother bird, having lost her child, circled above my head, crying mournfully.

I looked at the emergency exit. "Hello?" It felt as if he would greet me like that any moment. After all, my purpose of existence was not as clear as that of other neuro-consciousnesses. I was merely for display. That was all, and I had no specific mission like the waste disposal robots. I was just a giant statue resembling Gichan's old lover. Therefore, the disappearance of humans did not cause confusion in my value.

I was very calm. Humans, after all, lived in a different world from me. Sometimes, I even envied the waste disposal robots that mingled with humans. But now they were confused, and I was not. The mother bird cried out long once more in the sky. The sound seemed to be bidding me farewell. The bird, having lost its chick, had lost its reason to be here any longer.

Suddenly, I, too, wanted to leave. It felt as if Gichan was waiting for me at the end of the city's horizon. It wasn't that I was waiting; now, a desire to go stirred within me. I longed for wings on my shoulders. I wanted to become the old person, Lee Yeon-kyung, Gichan's lover, not the iron goddess atop the Tower of Babel.

It was a severance from long-held bondage. I twisted my body. With all my might. A roar pierced the silence of the quiet city. 'Thwack! Thwack!' The wires of my bondage snapped one by one. 'Flash!' My eyes lost their sight. Warning lamps began to light up one by one, and though it was painful, I considered it merely a

Cyborg. Oh, accursed fate.
Oh, mechanical tower built by human vanity.
When wind and sunlight kiss my cheek, my heart alone soars to the sky with those birds.
Cast off, oh cold shell.
Crumble, oh human Tower of Babel.
Severing the tedious wires of bondage,
I shall go before you, even as the wind.
2000. 1. 22

stories.title: 어느쪽 사랑을 고르시겠습니까 ?
stories.text:
프롤로그
사랑 이야기. 얼마만에 쓰는건가. 휴~ 생각해보면, 나의 첫 단편소설은 94년
 [아이들의 작은 이야기]였다. 중학생 소년소녀의 사랑이야기. 그 후로 많은
 것들을 끄적였다. [드라고니아의 전설], [작은마녀 윈디] 장편을 비롯해 여
러편의 단편들 대부분 소설들이 사랑이야기를 포함하고 있지만, 전적으로 사
랑이야기만 한 것은 95년 [유리구슬]밖에 없는 것 같다. 내 소설 사랑 이야기
의 주인공들은 대부분 죽었다. 이걸 지적해준 친구도 있었고, 사실 나두 알고
 있다. 모든 주인공들은 대부분 비극적 종말을 맞구.. (물론, 예외도 있었지만
 압도적으로 비극이 많다) 처음 쓴[아이들의~] 는 해피엔딩이었던것에 반해
대부분은..
 슬픈사랑이 아름답다거나, 죽음의미학 ? ... --; 뭐.. 아닐거다.
 아니, 그보다 진짜 사랑한번 못해본 나의 시샘일지두..
 그래서 그걸 좀 깨볼련다. [윈디]처럼 가볍지는 않고, 슬프지않은...
 또 하나의 Fstory를 하련다. Fine Story인지, Funny일지..
 Fatal이 될지도..
 - 강일석 24세 남 -
 사랑 ? 글쎄, 훗 모르겠다. 슬픈 사랑이 아름답다고 ? 그건 겪어보지 않은 이
들의 사치다. 슬픈사랑은 괴로움이고, 미련밖에 남기지 않는다. 사랑은 운명
인 것 같다. 원하지 않을 때 왔다가 원해도, 아무렇게나 떠나가는...
 - 유혜미 20세 여 -
 사랑 ? 자신한테 솔직한게 아닐까 ? 물론 상처받기도 한다. 중학교때 한번의
실연과 고등학교때 두번의 실연까지, 총 세 번이나 실연을 겪어봤다. 그중 두
 번은 시작하기도 전에 " 넌 싫어 !" 라고 어처구니 없이 아파하기도 전에 끝났
지만, 그 경험으로 두 번의 사랑을 해봤다. 물론, 지금은 그 두 번도 떠나갔지
만.. 처음은 내가 찾고, 또 한번은.. 이상하게 그저그렇게 멀어지더니, 헤어져
버렸다. 이렇게 얘기하니 내가 여자 카사노바 같군.
 제대로 사귀어본건 총 세 번, 그것도 다깨졌지만,
 1승 1무 1패로.. 차고, 채이고 다 해봤다.
 사랑은 만들어가는 것이다. 이렇게 전적이 화려하게 된것도, 그만큼 열심히
했다는 증거가 아닐까 ? 정말로 나에게 맞는 사람이 나타날때까지 나의 탐색
전은 계속 될 것 같다. 아직, 진정한 사랑은 나에게 오지 않았다. 진짜 나의
첫사랑은 언제쯤 ? 누군가 그러더라
 ' 여자의 현재의 사랑은 늘 첫사랑이다. '

 봄비가 내렸다. 학교는 새내기들의 신고식으로 왁자지껄, 저녁이 지나 밤이
 되었지만, 이맘때면 늘 그렇듯이 번쩍이는 술집 네온사인처럼 시끄럽기만 하
다. 학교앞 거리의 한 술집에서 새내기 환영식이 한창이다.
 " 얘 ! 겨레의 자랑 애국의 전톡 민족 S대학교 컴퓨터학부 빵빵학번 새내기
 유혜미 인사드립니다. "
 한 여학생이 한 무리 가운데 크게 자기 소개를 하고 있었다.
 " 야 ! 야 ! 여기 98학번 선배님도 계시는데 노래한곡해라. "
 " 예, 미스 00학번 진 ! 선배님들 앞에서 노래한곡 올려드릴게요 ! "
 아이들이 까르르 웃어젖혔다.
 " 야! 제 정말 대단한데. 요즘 새내기들 무섭다니까. "
 " 아~ ! 노래가 그냥나와요 ? 운을 띄워주셔야죠. "
 " S대의 명가수 유혜미를 소개합니다. 얼굴도 예쁘지만 노래또한 끝내줍니
다. 한박자쉬고, 두박자 쉬고, 세박자들어간다. 하나 둘 셋 넷 ! "
 " 사랑만 남겨놓고 떠나가느냐~ 얄미운 사랑! "
 아이들은 그녀의 구성진 목소리에 전부 뒤집어졌다.
그때 한 남학생이 술집으로 들어왔다.
 " 야~ 굉장한데. 00은 여자도 많네 ? "
 그제서야 무리 중 한 학생이 그 학생을 알아보았다.
 " 어! 일석이형 ! 드디어 제대했어요 ? "
 아이들은 순식간에 그 남학생에게 이목이 집중됬다.
 " 이분을 소개드리지. 이분이 96학번 강일석 선배님이셔. 과내동아리 NNS 재작년 회장이었지. "
 자리에 참석한 98,99들이 대단히 반가워하는 투였다.
 혜미에게 집중되었던 시선들이 일석이 한테 옮겨간건 순식간이었다. 이번 새
내기 환영식을 위해 준비했던것들이 갑자기 맥이 빠진듯한 느낌에 혜미는 약
간 기분이 상했다. 96이면 뵈지도않는데. 노땅이 갑자기 분위기를 휘어잡는
것 만큼은 용서할 수 없었다.
 " 아까, 저 여 학생이 노래하던차 아니었어 ? 대단한 것 같던데 ? "
 그 남학생은 자리에 앉으며 말했다.
 어쨌든 다시 띄워주긴 했지만, 분위기를 다시 만들어야 하는 것은 좀 곤란했
다. 그리고, 이상하게 98.99들의 눈치가 이상했다.
 눈치하나에는 도사인 혜미가 이런걸 모르는 것은 말이 안됐다. 다른 00들은
모르는 것 같았지만, 혜미에게는 선배들이 일석이란 사람의 눈치를 살피고
있는 것이 느껴졌다.
 혜미는 분위기를 살려보려 했지만, 98.99 선배들이 왠지 영 따라주지 않아
포기해버렸고, 신난건 철없는 다른 새내기들 뿐이었다. 흥이나지 않는 혜미
는 이내 분위기메이커에서 빠져버렸다.
 그때, 그 강일석이란 선배가 99과대에게 몇마디 소근대는걸 보았고, 99와 9
8의 대표자격 몇 명은 이나 다시 분위기에 동참했다.
 그러나, 혜미는 의무감에 의해 그런 것 같다고 느끼자 오히려 부아가 치
밀었다.
 ' 자기가 자리에서 빠지면 될걸, 후배들 시키냐 ? 원인을 없애야지. 군에서
 나쁜것만 배워왔나 보군. '
 어느새 그 원인은 그 선배라고 혜미는 점찍어 버렸다.
 그는 술도 입에 대지 않았고, 남들 이야기만 듣고만 있었지만 그의 존재감은
 대단했다.
 " 혜미라고 했나 ? 왠지 나에게 굉장한 불만이 있는 것 같다. "
혜미의 눈빛은 누가보아도 적의가 실려있다는 것을 쉽게 느낄수 있을 정도
였으니까.
 " 아, 아니에요. " 혜미는 입을 살짝 내밀며 고개를 돌려버렸다.
 " 아무래도, 난 이 자리에 적당치 않는 것 같군. 하긴 96이 여기와 있는 것 자
체가 주책이지. "
 그는 자리에서 일어섰다. 98들이 붙잡았지만, 그는 한사코 거절하고 자리를
떠났다. 어쨌든 맘에 안드는 혜미였다.
 그가 가고나자 분위기는 회복됬고, 혜미는 떠들기 시작했다.
 그리고 그녀는 00학번 과대가 되었다.
 " 안녕하십니까 ! 96학번 새내기 강일석입니다 ! "
 일석이의 새내기 환영식, 새내기들은 한명씩 자기소개를 했다.
 " 안녕하십니까 ! 96학번 새내기 진소연입니다. 전 듣지를 못하니 많은 도움
 부탁드립니다. "
 수줍은 말투에 수줍은 웃음, 일석은 그녀를 알아보고 깜짝 놀랐다. 그녀는 자
기 소개를 끝내고 자리에 앉았고, 일석은 잠시동안 그녀를 멍하니 쳐다보았다.
 그러다가 그녀도 일석을 발견했다. 자기를 쳐다보고 있는 시선에 우연이겠지
 하다가 계속 보고 있자 얼굴을 붉혔다.

"야, 니네집 제법 걷는구나. 이렇게나 후미진 곳이라니 여자애 혼자 안 무
섭냐?"
"보통은 일찍 들어가요. 그리고 아까도 말했듯 무서운건 없어요."
그러다가 더 어두운 골목이 그들 앞에 나타났다.
"이런 가로등이 망가졌네." 혜미는 난감한 듯 말했다.
"역시 무서운건 아니야?" 일석이 놀리듯 말했다.
"아니에요, 그저 기분이 나쁠뿐."
그러나 그길을 갈때는 혜미가 일석의 손을 잡았다. 일석이는 역시 이 아이
도 여자구나 생각했다. 그길을 지나자 혜미는 자연스레 손을 뺐다.
"역시 무서웠던게구나." 일석이는 놀렸다.
"아니라니까요!" 신경질적인 말투였다.
"후훗, 뭐가아니야?"
"다 왔어요." 혜미는 한집앞에 섰다.
"잘가." "예. 오빠도 조심해 가요."
"혜미야!" "예?"
혜미가 막 들어가려고 하다가 뒤를 돌아보았다.
"넌 눈이 참 예뻐."
"예?"
"눈말이야 눈!"
그러자 혜미는 갑자기 화난 얼굴로 바뀌었다.
"뭐예요! 뭐가 눈이 가장 예쁘다는 거예요? 꼴도보기 싫어!"
'쾅!'혜미는 문을 쾅 닫고 들어가 버렸다.
'내가 뭘 실수한 건지? 단지 예쁘다고 한 것 뿐인데...'
다음날 일석이는 여느때처럼 등교했다. 저 앞에서 혜미가 오는게 보였다
. 일석이가 손을 흔들었지만 얼굴을 돌려버렸다.
'완전히 미움을 사버렸군, 근데 왜지? 영문도 모르고 이거야 원.'
"혜미야!" "왜불러요? 일석선배." 그러나 그녀의 말은 앙칼졌다.
'왜 열받았냐? 내가 나쁜짓한 기억은 없는데 이유도 모르고 미움 받는
건 기분 나쁘잖아."
"눈이 예쁘다고 했잖아요."
"그게 뭐? 예쁘단 말도 듣기싫냐?"
"제 경우엔 컴플랙스라구요."
"그럼, 넌 그 눈을 못생겼다고 생각하니?"
"그건 아니구요 제가 예전에... 아니 됐어요."
뭔가 말하려다 그만뒀다. 그리곤 휑하니 프로젝트실 밖으로 나가 버렸다.
 일석이가 저녁때 쯤 집에 돌아가려고 교정을 나설무렵이었다. 교정의
농구코트에 한여학생혼자 농구를 하고 있는걸 발견했다. 일석이는 가방을
 내려놓고 코트 옆으로 가서 구경을 했다. 혼자 드리블, 슛, 땀흘리며 남자
못지 않는 몸동작을 하고있는 것은 다름아닌 혜미였다. 그렇게 한 20분쯤 멍
하니 보고 있었을까? 빗나간 공이 일석이 앞으로 굴러왔다. 일석은 그 공을 집었다.
"정말 잘하네..."
슛, 일석이는 골을 향해 공을 던졌다. 그러나 공은 백보드에 맞지도 않고 포물
선으로 떨어지고 말았고 혜미는 그 공을 잡아 레이업으로 넣으며 말했다.
"정말 못하시네요." 여전히 그 목소리에는 화가 실려 있었다.
"그렇게 까지 말하면 섭섭한데. 하긴 인정한다. 못하긴 못하지. 농구공은 잡아
본적도 없으니. 넌 정말 잘하는데?"
"고등학교때까지 농구부였으니까요."
"그래? 정말 굉장한데. 나도 좀 배울 수 있을까?"
혜미는 슛을 막 넣으려다 그말을 듣고 일석이를 놀라는 눈빛으로
 바라보았다. 눈이 마주친 일석은 씩 웃어보였다. 잠깐 그렇게 시
간이 흘렀다. 그러다 이내 일석이 진지한 눈빛에 혜미도 큭큭큭 웃
더니만 공을 튀기며 일석에게 다가오며 말했다.
"좋아요, 좋아졌어요. 가르쳐드리죠. 오빠는 사람이 너무 좋은 것
 같다. 제가 그렇게 굴었는데도 싫지 않았어요?"
"나도 괴팍한 여동생이 있거든."
혜미는 일석에게 패스했다. "기본부터 가르쳐 드리지요."
혜미와 일석은 어둑어둑 해질때까지 농구연습을 했다.
"받아요."
퍽! 그러나 그공은 또 일석의 얼굴에 맞아버렸다.
"괜찮아요?" 혜미는 놀라서 뛰어왔다.
"아...너무 어두워서 잘 안보이는 구나. 이제 그만하자."
일석과 혜미는 숨을 몰아쉬었다. 혜미는 이마에  흐르는 땀을 닦으며
말했다.
"오랜만에 즐거웠어요. 그래도 빨리 느는 것 같은데요? 한 일 주일
만 하면..."
"그래? 그럼 내일도 해줄래?"
"음...글쎄요. 생각해 볼게요." 혜미는 새침하게 말했지만 긍정의 뜻이
 담겨있는 것 같았다.
"이제는 집에 가야지 않나? 버스정류장까지 같이가자."
일석과 혜미는 가방을 챙겨 학교앞 버스정류장까지 걷기 시작했다.
"어제 미안했어요."
혜미가 문득 말했다.
"뭘?"
"화낸거요. 사실 선배한테는 잘못도 없는데요. 눈 얘기만 하면 예민해
져요. 고3때 농구를 하다 공에 눈이 맞고 다쳤어요. 엄마가 농구하는거
 알면 죽이려 들걸요?"
"그래서 니눈이 안예쁘다는 거야?"
"아니요, 그래서 실명했었죠."
"뭐?" 일석은 놀라서 되물었다.
"지금 제눈은 이식 받은 거에요. 그나마 운이 좋았죠. 맞는게 있었으니.
 그래서 어둠이 싫어요, 실명한 삼개월은 지옥같았죠."
"그래서 그랬구나 와하핫."
일석이는 크게 웃었다.
"왜웃어요 비웃는 거에요?" 혜미가 소리질렀다.
"아, 아니야. 바보야 남자가 눈이 예뻐요 라고 말하면 넌 그게 넌 눈
만예뻐. 라고 말하는 것 같니?"
"예?" 혜미가 놀라며 되물었다. 둘은 버스정류장에 도착했다.
"11일 있으면 4월 14일이다. 너 올해도 짜장면 먹을 거니? 난 먹기
 싫은데."
"그게 무슨말이에요?" 혜미는 얼굴이 빨게져서 다시 물었다.
그때 일석의 집으로 가는 버스가 도착했다.
"앗, 차 왔다. 나 먼저 갈게. 무슨말인지는 집에가며 생각해 보렴."
일석은 훌쩍 차에 올랐다. 버스 차 밖으로 멀어져가는 혜미의 모습이
 보였다. 일석은 웃으며 손을 흔들어 주었다.
'띠리리~~' 일석의 핸드폰이 울렸다.
"여보세요." "여보세요, 일석이 형이에요? 저 99승민이요."
"아 그래 왠일이냐?" "내일 99대 00농구시합이 있거든요."
"근데, 왜?" "지난번에 당한 걸 복수할 생각이거든요. 새내기들에게 헌내기의 위력을 보여주게요." "그런데 쓰레기인 나한테 왜 전화한 거야?"
 " S대 최고의 농구선수인 일석 형님을 모셔야 Dream team이.. "
 " 어쩌지.. 미안한데. "
일석은 난처한 듯 말했다.
 " 어 ? 안돼여 ? "
 " 상대편에 혜미도 있지 ? "
 " 그 아이가 제일 강적이에요. "
 " 안돼. 아. 그리구, 혜미한테 내가 농구 좀 했다 뭐 이런 소리하면 가만
안둔다. 혜미한테 농구배우고 있다고.. "
 " 어 ? 설마. 형. 어제 영화건도 그래서. "
 " 혜미한테는 비밀이다. "
 " 소연누나가 하늘에서 울어요. "
 " 아니야. 사실이것도 소연이하고 약속을 지키는거야. "
 " 그게 무슨소리에요 ? "
 " 알것없어. 그럼 끊자. "
 " 예. 하는 수 없죠. "

 - 강일석 24세 남 -
 사랑은 만들어 가는거다. 누구나 거창하고 아름다운 사랑이야기를 꿈꾸지
만, 사실은 가장 평범한 사랑이 신께 축복받았다는 증거다. 사랑을 두 연인
 끼리 만들어 나갈 수 있도록 신이 내버려 둔다면, 이미 그것은 신의 축복받
은 사랑이다. 만약, 신에 의해 어쩔 수 없는 사랑을 하게 된다면 사랑을 하
는 사람들에게는 비극이다. 나는 그녀의 유언을 지킬 것 이다.
 ' 나를 기억하는 건 우리가 만났던, 3월까지만 하렴. 나를 잊고 더 이상
 슬퍼하지마. 4월 19일 혼자 짜장면 먹으면 가만 안둘거야. 나하고 이
루지 못했던 평범한 사랑을 해봐. 하늘에서 꼭 지켜보고 있을거야. '
 그녀의 마지막 편지구절이었다. 그러나 잊으라는 유언은 못지킬 것 같다.
 " 다녀왔습니다. "
 혜미는 어머니께 인사했다.
 " 얘야. 왠 땀. 너 혹시 농구했니 ? "
 " 아니에요. 요 앞에서 운동삼아 뛰어왔어요. "
 " 아. 독산동 아주머니한테 전화왔다. "
 " 독산동이요 ? 누구요 ? "
 " 얘는 네 눈 이식시켜준 집 말이다. 그 집 딸이 심장병으로 죽어가면서
 너에게 준거 아니니. 기억안나니 ? 너도 한번 그 애 만나봤을텐데. 청각
장애자였잖아. 젊은 나이에 안됐지. 소연인가.. 소현인가... "

 - 유혜미 20세 여 -
 사랑은 운명인 것 같다. 무언가 알 수 없는 힘에 이끌리는 것. 처음본 사
람에게 어떤 감정이 일어나는 것은 어떤 과학적, 의학적 자료로도 설명할
 수 없다. 처음봤던 그 남자가 자꾸 눈에 밟혔던 그때도..

 에필로그
 결국 다 썼습니다. 여자친구도 없는 제가 연애소설을 다 쓰고..
사랑의 정의에 관해 논한 것 자체가 우습지만..
상상만으로도 재미는 있으니까..
 가치관 뒤바꾸기를 목표로 억지로 구성하다보니.. 약간의 억지성도..
타이핑을 도움주신 사촌누나에게도 감사를.. ^^
 육군대구병원에서 썼습니다.
